title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 12: King Jehoash of Judah, the money chest for repairing Yahweh's house, Hazael's threat and the conspiracy against Joash.

questions.text: What was the name of Jehoash's mother?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:1 says his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

questions.text: Jehoash did what was right in Yahweh's eyes all the days in which who instructed him?
questions.explanation: Jehoash did what was right all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

questions.text: What was not taken away during Jehoash's reign, so that the people still sacrificed and burned incense there?
questions.explanation: The high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burned incense in them.

questions.text: By which year of King Jehoash had the priests still not repaired the damage to the house?
questions.explanation: By the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

questions.text: Where did Jehoiada set the chest with a hole bored in its lid?
questions.explanation: He set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh's house.

answers.text: Outside the gate of the king's house
Beside the altar, on the right side
In the treasury of the king's house
At the entrance to the city of David

questions.text: Who came up and counted the money when they saw there was much money in the chest?
questions.explanation: When there was much money in the chest, the king's scribe and the high priest came up, put it in bags and counted it.

answers.text: The king's scribe and the high priest

questions.text: Why did they not demand an accounting from the men who received the money for the workers?
questions.explanation: They didn't demand an accounting from them, for they dealt faithfully.

answers.text: Because the king had forbidden it
Because the money had run out
Because the priests were too busy

questions.text: To whom did the money for the trespass offerings and the sin offerings belong?
questions.explanation: That money was not brought into Yahweh's house; it was the priests'.

questions.text: Which city did Hazael king of Syria fight against and take before he set his face to go up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Hazael king of Syria fought against Gath and took it, and then set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which of Joash's servants struck him so that he died?
questions.explanation: Jozacar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died.
